cohort: The study included 11,083,180 delivery hospitalizations across the United States from 2016 to 2018.
finding: Rates of long-acting reversible contraception (LARC) insertion increased, while rates of inpatient postpartum tubal ligations slowly declined between 2016 and 2018.
mod_finding: Women who underwent a cesarean delivery had higher odds of having a tubal ligation compared to those who had a vaginal delivery.
